El uso más visible de los autocodificado: The most visible use of autoencoders is not generating but compressing meaningfully: systems that look for similar images or documents store each item's code and compare codes, which are far smaller than the data. They are also used to detect anomalies, with an elegant trick: it is trained only on normal examples, and when something odd arrives the autoencoder reconstructs it badly, so a high reconstruction error is the alarm. That is how industrial engines and bank transactions are watched. And the part of the VAE that has stayed for good is the idea of a continuous latent space you can sample from, which is what diffusion models use afterwards.
